face_front.name: front portrait
face_front.label: character
face_front.caption: A straight-on head-and-chest portrait of the character, cropped at the upper chest. The complete head silhouette fills the portrait area.

face_left.name: right-facing profile portrait
face_left.label: character
face_left.caption: A head-and-chest portrait in strict side profile facing image-right, showing the character's anatomical left side. The complete head silhouette is visible, cropped at the upper chest.

face_right.name: left-facing profile portrait
face_right.label: character
face_right.caption: A head-and-chest portrait in strict side profile facing image-left, showing the character's anatomical right side. The complete head silhouette is visible, cropped at the upper chest.

face_3q_left.name: right-facing three-quarter portrait
face_3q_left.label: character
face_3q_left.caption: A head-and-chest portrait turned 45 degrees toward image-right, showing the front and the character's left cheek. The complete head silhouette is visible, cropped at the upper chest.

face_3q_right.name: left-facing three-quarter portrait
face_3q_right.label: character
face_3q_right.caption: A head-and-chest portrait turned 45 degrees toward image-left, showing the front and the character's right cheek. The complete head silhouette is visible, cropped at the upper chest.

face_back.name: rear portrait
face_back.label: character
face_back.caption: A head-and-shoulders portrait viewed directly from behind: the back of the complete head, neck and shoulders, with the head facing straight away from the viewer.

body_front.name: full-body front view
body_front.label: character
body_front.caption: A front-facing full-body depiction in a neutral standing pose. The complete head, hair and both feet or footwear are visible, with clear space above the head and below the soles.

body_left.name: full-body anatomical-left profile
body_left.label: character
body_left.caption: A strict anatomical-left profile of the full body in a neutral standing pose. The nose, chest and toes point toward the right edge of the image. The complete head and both feet or footwear are inside the depiction; the character is not a mirrored copy of the front view.

body_back.name: full-body rear view
body_back.label: character
body_back.caption: A direct rear full-body depiction in a neutral standing pose. The complete head and both feet or footwear are visible. Only the rear-facing surfaces are shown; the face and eyes are not visible and the head is not turned.

clothing_front.name: front clothing detail
clothing_front.label: object
clothing_front.caption: A flat-lay of the empty outfit, front sides up. Clothing only.

clothing_back.name: rear clothing detail
clothing_back.label: object
clothing_back.caption: A flat-lay of the empty outfit, back sides up. Clothing only.

hands.name: paired hand detail
hands.label: object
hands.caption: An isolated close-up of the character's two complete hands, one anatomical left hand and one anatomical right hand, cropped at the wrists. Both hands and any described gloves are inside this region, without a head, torso or whole figure.

feet.name: paired foot or footwear detail
feet.label: object
feet.caption: An isolated close-up of one left foot and one right foot, or their footwear, with both complete silhouettes visible. Any described boot shafts are included. Closed footwear has continuous outer material over the toes; skin is visible only at genuine openings. No head, torso or whole figure is present.

styles.anime: Anime illustration with controlled linework and cel shading.
styles.photo: Photographic rendering with realistic surface textures and soft, even studio light.
styles.realistic_painting: Realistic painted forms with coherent anatomy and readable material rendering.
styles.semi_realistic_anime: Anime-derived features with softly modeled, semi-realistic shading.
styles.oil_painting: Oil-painted rendering with visible, controlled brushwork.
styles.watercolor: Watercolor pigment washes with clearly defined silhouettes.
styles.gouache: Opaque gouache color shapes with readable contours.
styles.colored_pencil: Colored-pencil rendering with visible strokes and clearly defined forms.
styles.3d: Three-dimensional rendered surfaces with coherent materials and soft studio lighting.

summary.multi_intro: A character design sheet presents {count} separate views of one character on {background}.
summary.single_intro: A single-view character design depiction on {background}.
summary.consistency: The different views depict one consistent character, with matching identity, proportions, outfit colors, materials and anatomical asymmetries.
summary.body_alignment: The full-body depictions in each row have matching scale and aligned sole levels.
summary.appearance_scope: Only the portions described in each view are visible; appearance details do not change the assigned viewpoint or crop.
summary.blank_sheet: The surrounding space is blank, without sheet-level titles, panel labels, watermarks, drawn borders or alignment marks. Explicitly described lettering on a garment or accessory belongs only on that surface.

hand_state.bare: Visible hands are bare rather than gloved.
hand_state.gloved: Visible hands wear gloves; their design follows the applicable hand description.

footwear_state.shod: Visible feet wear footwear rather than being bare.
footwear_state.unshod: Visible feet are bare rather than wearing shoes or boots.

clothing_type.pants: The lower garment is trousers rather than a skirt or robe.
clothing_type.skirt_robe: The lower garment is a skirt or robe rather than trousers.

local_suffix: These appearance details apply only to surfaces visible within this framing and from this viewpoint.
composition_rules: Preserve canonical view order and actual layout boxes. Every selected view produces one item; portraits are never merged into an extra grid item.

If any clothing view or at least three portrait views are selected, build the summary from compact_summary, concise actual group composition, the unmodified design reference once, and user-specified outfit, style and other details. Use compact_views. Do not append legacy scope or consistency paragraphs.
Otherwise preserve the existing single/three/five/seven-view templates and serialization.
Append only visible part and appearance settings to each view. Clothing views receive neither facial nor hand instructions; lower_body uses a garment-only prefix in clothing views.
Convert pixel xyxy boxes into centered yxyx exactly once. Serialize compact JSON in layout mode; use shared text and position-aware per-view blocks in caption mode.

compact_views.face_left: A close-up headshot, side profile facing right, cropped at the shoulders.
compact_views.face_right: A close-up headshot, side profile facing left, cropped at the shoulders.
compact_views.face_3q_left: A close-up headshot, three-quarter view facing right, cropped at the shoulders.
compact_views.face_3q_right: A close-up headshot, three-quarter view facing left, cropped at the shoulders.
compact_views.face_back: A close-up of the back of the head and shoulders.
compact_views.body_front: One full-length standing figure, front view.
compact_views.body_left: One full-length standing figure, side profile facing right.
compact_views.body_back: One full-length standing figure, back view.
compact_views.clothing_front: A flat-lay of the empty outfit, front sides up. Clothing only.
compact_views.clothing_back: A flat-lay of the empty outfit, back sides up. Clothing only.
compact_views.hands: A close-up of the pair of hands, side by side, cropped at the wrists.
compact_views.feet: A close-up of the pair of feet and their footwear, side by side.
